summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of Stephen Randolph Lorenz, a retired United States Air Force four-star general. It states he is now president and CEO of the United States Air Force Academy Endowment. It describes his final military post as 29th Commander of Air Education and Training Command at Randolph Air Force Base, Texas, and the scope of that command's responsibilities and resources.
one_line: Retired USAF four-star general Stephen R. Lorenz, former commander of Air Education and Training Command, now heads the Air Force Academy Endowment.
key_facts: Stephen Randolph Lorenz was born October 17, 1951.
Stephen R. Lorenz is a retired United States Air Force four-star general.
Stephen R. Lorenz currently serves as president and chief executive officer of the United States Air Force Academy Endowment.
His last military assignment was as the 29th Commander of Air Education and Training Command (AETC).
Air Education and Training Command is headquartered at Randolph Air Force Base, Texas.
As commander of Air Education and Training Command, Stephen R. Lorenz was responsible for the recruiting, training and education of all US Airmen.
The Air Education and Training Command included the Air Force Recruiting Service, two numbered air forces and Air University.
Air Education and Training Command consists of 13 bases.
Air Education and Training Command has more than 92,000 active duty, reserve, guard, civilians and contractors.
Air Education and Training Command operates 1,750 trainer, fighter and mobility aircraft.
